commands.name: Display Screenshot Data
commands.description: Read the oscilloscope screen image as an IEEE 488.2 definite-length binary block.
commands.response_notes: Programmer's Guide supports BMP, BMP8bit and PNG with COLor or GRAYscale palette. Real DSO-X 3034A hardware appends the configured termination after the block; screenshot readers must consume that terminator before the next text query.
commands.notes: Hardware verified 2026-09-02 with PNG,COLor in the Instrument Screenshot operation. After fixing binary termination handling, 5 consecutive screenshots completed successfully in one VISA session and SYSTem:ERRor? remained clean. Large binary transfer; do not execute in generic safe probe.

commands.name: Hardcopy Ink Saver
commands.description: Control whether graticule colors are inverted for hardcopy/display image output.
commands.response_notes: 0 means OFF and 1 means ON. For a normal non-inverted screenshot, the Programmer's Guide recommends INKSaver OFF before :DISPlay:DATA?.
commands.notes: Hardware verified 2026-09-02 on the reference DSO-X 3034A. After 5 consecutive screenshots, :HARDcopy:INKSaver? returned 0 and SYSTem:ERRor? returned 0,No error.
